Lean.Compiler.CSimp.State.map.fullDefinition: map : SMap Name Name := {}   thmNames : SSet Name := {}   deriving Inhabited
Lean.Compiler.CSimp.State.map.description: A method that transforms the state of a simplification compiler into a mapping of names.

Lean.Compiler.CSimp.add.fullDefinition: def add (declName : Name) (kind : AttributeKind) : CoreM Unit := do   if let some entry ← isConstantReplacement? declName then     ext.add entry kind   else     throwError "invalid 'csimp' theorem, only constant replacement theorems (e.g., `@f = @g`) are currently supported."
Lean.Compiler.CSimp.add.description: A function that adds a declaration name with a specified attribute kind to the simplification compiler's context.
